title: Seeking Serenity | KEY.co
description_expanded: This breathtaking Dune Allen Beach retreat offers an unparalleled blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm. Designed to accommodate up to 26 guests, this eight-bedroom, eight-full-bath, and two-half-bath masterpiece spans three stories, complete with a private resort-style pool and spa, an outdoor summer kitchen, and multiple balconies with stunning Gulf views. The thoughtfully designed interior boasts high-end finishes, contemporary décor, and open-concept living spaces perfect for gathering. A chef’s dream kitchen, multiple media rooms, and an elevator to all levels ensure that every detail is curated for relaxation and convenience. For adventure seekers, a 6-seater golf cart and six adult bikes provide easy access to the pristine beaches and charming local spots along 30A.

Features: Outdoor Pool Heated pool Hot tub
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
